Ullaṅgha(dhya)
Bud.
--Nidāna or Pratītyasamutpādaśāstra, in 30 Kārikās with C. Nanjio 1227.
Ed.. an. study of Chinese version an. German transl. V. V. Gokhale, Bonn 1930.
--Mahāyānanidānaśāstra. ib. 1314.

Ullāgharāghava
nāṭaka. by Someśvara, a protege of Vastupāla, minister of Gujarat (13th cent.).
Ed.. GOS. CXXXII.

Ullāsa
or Daśollāsa, on the sports of Rādhā an. Kṛṣṇa. by Viṭṭhaleśvara, son of Vallabha.
Pt.. in the collection of Śṛṅgārarasamaṇḍana, Bombay, 1919. Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 1270.

Ullāsadāsa
brother of Vilāsadāsa an. stepgrandfather of Viśvanāthadāsa. Mentioned, J. of Ori. Res., M. S. Uni., Baroda, III. p. 358. [Page399-a.

Ullāsikastotra
Jain. Pkt. another name of Laghu Ajitaśāntistava by Jinavallabha Sūri. See under Ajitaśāntistava, NCC. I. p. 68a.
